thread.title: EU Mulls 'Digital Tax' On Apple, Facebook, Google; S&P 500, Dow Jones Futures Fall

author: ED CARSON
title: EU Mulls 'Digital Tax' On Apple, Facebook, Google; S&P 500, Dow Jones Futures Fall
text:
The European Union is poised to consider a 3% tax on digital revenue, hitting U.S. tech giants such as Apple ( AAPL ), Facebook ( FB ), Google-parent Alphabet ( GOOGL ), Amazon ( AMZN ) and Netflix ( NFLX ).
X The European Commission will propose a tax on digital revenue next week, according to the Financial Times , which follows earlier reports suggesting the EU's executive arm was planning some sort of digital tax. If true, that would raise trade tensions with the U.S. on the heels of President Donald Trump imposing steel and aluminum tariffs.
The digital tax would have three parts. It'll tax advertising revenues from the likes of Google, Facebook and, increasingly, Amazon. It'll tax fees from digital subscribers to services such as Apple Music, Spotify and Netflix. And it'll tax revenue from firms selling digital data to third parties.
By targeting revenue vs. profit, the EU aims to prevent global tax giants from avoiding taxes. But there's no doubt that the tax would fall primarily on U.S. tech and internet giants. The European Union recently imposed a big fine on Google over search results and ordered Apple to pay a big back-tax bill to Ireland.

So the policy may never pass or face major revisions.
Stock futures briefly sold off on the report, but soon moved back to little changed.
